# Vendored wheels for the Workbench

Pure-Python packages the Workbench installs in the browser (Pyodide) with micropip:

| Wheel | Used for | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| python_docx-1.1.2-py3-none-any.whl | Reading .docx documents and writing Word reports | MIT (https://github.com/python-openxml/python-docx) |
| pypdf-5.1.0-py3-none-any.whl | Reading .pdf documents | BSD-3-Clause (https://github.com/py-pdf/pypdf) |

Unchanged copies of the files published on PyPI.
